central_aisle.exception_reason: Same QA ruling as the yard (Jett, 2026-11-22): DESIGN S3's specific blackjack placements WIN over S1's general aisle rule; the exemption covers the two tables and their 1.5-unit rings where they overlap the aisle.
central_aisle.rule: Interior continuation of the DESIGN S1 aisle, shifted +200 X. Keep clear of furniture/decor. Flat floor pieces (the tongue carpet runner) define the aisle and are exempt, exactly as in the yard.

rules.clear_ring_rule: Same as yard: no decor/furniture inside a game table's 1.5-unit ring. Bot dealer anchors (BotStation_*) sit on the dealer side by DESIGN S5 and are exempt; hanging signs (Y>=3.5) and on-table dressing are not ground intrusions.
rules.enclosure_rule: The interior is a fully enclosed shell (floor, 4 walls, ceiling at Y=8). No windows to the yard. The yard sky/lighting must never be visible from inside, and the interior must never be visible from the yard - the 200-unit gap plus the sealed shell guarantee both.
rules.naming_rule: Station and anchor names are EXACT DESIGN.md S3/S5 names (PokerTable_Main, BotStation_Blackjack, ...). They exist ONCE in the scene - here. The yard copies in 01-layout must be removed in the integration pass or GameObject.Find(name) becomes ambiguous (see INTERIOR.md).
rules.rotation_convention: rotation_y_deg: 0 = facing north (+Z), 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west. Same convention as 01-layout.

entry_point.note: Teleport landing, NOT the world spawn. Mirrors the yard SpawnPoint's local position (20,0,3) so the interior reads instantly: marquee overhead, carpet/tongue runner leading north to the tables.

grid.axes: X east, Z north, Y up; floor top at Y=0 (same plane as the yard)

offset.rule: Every interior coordinate = the DESIGN.md yard-grid coordinate with X + 200. Z and Y are UNCHANGED. Local grid X 0-40 maps to world X 200-240; local Z 0-30 and all heights are identical to DESIGN.md S3/S5.
offset.why_this_offset: See INTERIOR.md 'Where the interior sits'. Short version: same Y=0 ground plane (gravity, floor, seating and spawn logic behave exactly as in the yard), 200 units east is far beyond the yard's 40-unit width and any normal draw/sight range from the yard, and the +200 shift makes the station-script integration pass a mechanical x+200 per hardcoded centre.
